headline: Kai, inflation stuck at 3.4 percent, Wednesday's hike is 91 percent priced, and stocks rallied anyway.
subline: A quarter-point Fed move now looks all but assured, oil eased back to $100 as Hormuz traffic thinned to seven ships a day, and bitcoin sat out the week near $77,000.
asof: Saturday · markets closed · stocks, yields, gold and oil are Friday's close · bitcoin live as of ~6:40 AM ET · every figure links to its source below

items.title: Stocks snap a four-day slide on CPI day
items.sentence: The S&P 500 rose 0.9 percent to 7,656.98, the Dow added 509 points to 52,573.29 and the Nasdaq closed at 26,333.04, per the AP's Friday wrap.

items.title: August CPI holds at 3.4%, core runs hot
items.sentence: Consumer prices rose 0.4 percent on the month and 3.4 percent on the year, with core a tenth above forecast at 0.3 percent, per TheStreet, which says analysts now call next week's hike all but assured.

items.title: Markets price Wednesday's hike at 91 percent
items.sentence: Money markets put the odds of a quarter-point increase at next week's Fed meeting at 91 percent, and five-year inflation expectations climbed to 2.46 percent from 2.37 at the start of the week, per FXStreet.

items.title: The 10-year ends the week at 4.97%
items.sentence: The benchmark closed at 4.97 percent per Trading Economics, capping a week FXStreet counts at more than 16 basis points of climb, with the 30-year touching 5.38 percent intraday, its highest since 2007.

items.title: Oil eases; gold closes the week flat
items.sentence: WTI settled at $100.05 and Brent at $104.61, both down more than 2 percent on the day, while gold finished at $4,408.90, up all of $1.60, per Investrade's market review.

items.title: Bitcoin steadies at $77,214 after a down week
items.sentence: Coinbase marks bitcoin at $77,214 early Saturday, up 0.4 percent over the past 24 hours from $77,042, treading water while rates repriced around it.

items.title: Houthis take Mocha, complete Red Sea coast control
items.sentence: Thursday's seizure of Mocha puts Iranian-aligned forces at both the Hormuz and Bab el-Mandeb chokepoints, and only seven ships transited Hormuz that day against a prewar norm near 125, per GlobalSecurity's day-196 report.

items.title: Drones from Iraq ignite a Saudi pipeline
items.sentence: Euronews's Saturday morning bulletin reports drones launched from Iraq struck and set fire to a pipeline inside Saudi Arabia.

items.title: Trump declines Saudi request for strikes on Houthis
items.sentence: Crown Prince Mohammed bin Salman called President Trump twice asking for American strikes on the Houthis and was turned down as Washington weighs escalation risks, per Just Security's briefing.

items.title: Treasury sanctions Iran's proxy financiers in four countries
items.sentence: New U.S. sanctions hit entities in Iraq, the UAE, Lebanon and Turkey that support Hezbollah and Iranian proxies, with a major bank due for designation next week, per Just Security.

items.title: Supreme Court blocks Missouri's redrawn House map
items.sentence: The Court ordered Missouri to run November's midterms on its prior district lines rather than the new Republican-drawn map, per Just Security.

items.title: OpenAI ships GPT-Live-1, a full-duplex voice API
items.sentence: The model holds both sides of a conversation at once and prices at $0.05 a minute, per AlphaSignal, which says it cuts voice-agent code by 80 percent.

items.title: Apple's A20 Pro is the first 2nm phone chip
items.sentence: The iPhone 18 Pro's chip is the first built on a 2-nanometer process, per MacRumors, and AI Weekly notes its dual 16-core Neural Engines double on-device AI throughput.

items.title: Anthropic details AI-assisted cyberattacks and surveillance
items.sentence: A new report documents AI-assisted intrusion and surveillance operations from December through August, with smaller actors expanding capability while humans still choose the targets, per AI Weekly.

items.title: Positron raises $875 million against the HBM squeeze
items.sentence: The startup closed an $875 million Series C at a $5 billion valuation to build inference chips around commodity memory rather than scarce high-bandwidth stacks, per AI Weekly.

items.title: CNBC: 'model fatigue' hits the frontier labs
items.sentence: CNBC reports fatigue setting in among users and enterprises as Meta, Google, OpenAI and Anthropic roll out new model versions at a frenetic pace.
